title: Search a 2D Matrix
kidExplanation: A matrix where each row is sorted and rows increase. Treat it like one long sorted list.
plainProblem: LeetCode 74: Search a 2D Matrix. Restate the official prompt in your own words, list inputs and outputs, then solve a tiny example by hand before coding.

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For Search a 2D Matrix, first describe a slow but correct approach (often nested loops or rescanning).

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the loops. If work looks like n×n, say so. Google interviewers want that honesty.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: Since both the rows and columns in the input 2D matrix are sorted, we can treat the matrix as a one-dimensional sorted array and perform binary search to find the target element. We can map the 2D indices to the corresponding index in the 1D array and then apply binary search to locate the target element.

thinkingSteps.title: Better idea
thinkingSteps.body: Write the optimal plan in 3 bullets, then code. Walk example 1 with your finger on each variable.
